lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots positioned posterior to the branchial area, with the largest centroids concentrated in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a distinct grid-like structural arrangement across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the upper edge to shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small high-luminance spots across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple smaller fish silhouettes (remoras) located ventral to the primary pectoral fin and along the lower flank.
